description: A duel tournament: every model plays every other once, five duels a pairing. Level-60 Frost Mages in identical gear and talents (kit frost-60-pvp), face to face 8 yards apart at an open spot of their own; the eight pairs of a round duel at once at eight spots out of sight of each other, fifteen rounds in all. Scored on duels won, rated Bradley-Terry across every pairing.
